newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee gains vs dlr as Reserve Bank abstains.
newsitem.headline: India rupee gains vs dlr as Reserve Bank abstains.

text.p: The Indian rupee gained to 35.830/845 against the dollar in afternoon spot trade, up from Friday's opening level of 35.865/875, dealers said.

"RBI (the Reserve Bank of India) is not there," said a dealer. RBI, the central bank, has been the major dollar buyer in recent months. There was no demand from state-run commercial banks either, dealers said.
"So the longs are getting liquidated," said a dealer.
The rupee has tended to appreciate in recent months on the back of large inflows and RBI has been mopping up excess dollars to arrest the rupee's rise against the dollar.
